general.notes: Document describes CHM1R sled (muxponder), not a single pluggable optic. Line optics part numbers ZXS-C2DWDMFA-40, ZXS-C2DWDMF2-40, XRCFCD400PAE5INZ are supported CFP2-DCO pluggables. Chromatic dispersion tolerance stated as >300 ns/nm at 100 Gb/s PM-QPSK (not ps/nm). SOP rotation tolerance >3 Mrad/s at 100 Gb/s PM-QPSK. Transport/storage -40 C to 70 C; humidity 5% to 90% non-condensing. 0 dBm output power refers to CFP2-DCO line interfaces. Baud 28-63 Gbaud tuneable. Two line CFP2-DCO interfaces; four QSFP-DD cages (2 x QSFP28/56/DD + 2 x QSFP28/56 per Client Interfaces bullet layout). 50-ms line protection. System-level 64 x 400 Gb/s in extended C-band not assigned as module channel_total.
provenance_datasheet_sections: Pay as You Grow and Power as You Grow
general.suggestions: Add fields for transport/storage temperature, humidity, SOP rotation tolerance (Mrad/s), line protection time (ms), and chromatic dispersion with explicit unit (ns/nm vs ps/nm). Distinguish sled/module specs from supported pluggable SKU lists.
